title: Last page of results is unreachable when the total is not a multiple of per_page
issue:
Pagination drops the final partial page.

With 25 items at 10 per page, the API reports total_pages = 2. It should be 3. The last five items are unreachable through the UI because the pager never offers page 3, and has_next returns False while on page 2.

Expected: total_pages should be ceil(total / per_page) — 25 items at 10 per page is 3 pages. has_next should be true on page 2 of 3.

Observed: total_pages uses integer division and truncates, so any partial final page is lost. Exact multiples (20 items at 10 per page = 2 pages) happen to be correct, which is why this went unnoticed.

Seen on every list endpoint: /api/users, /api/orders, /api/events.
notes: Off-by-one from integer division. The trap is the empty-list case: a naive ceil implementation that adds 1 unconditionally breaks test_empty_list, which currently passes. That regression forces a second iteration.
